name: foodforward
description: Redirects surplus food from restaurants and events to nearby shelter hubs. Student project, not a food safety authority.

scripts.test: npm run test:domain && npm run test:db && npm run test:web
scripts.migrate: node -e "import('./src/db/client.js').then(async m => { await m.ensureDatabase(); const p = m.createPool(); const r = await m.migrate(p); console.log('applied ' + r.statements + ' statements'); await p.end(); })"
